SALVO

AI-Powered Autonomous Water Rescue

Spots a person in distress. Tracks them. Deploys a flotation device. Pings the nearest lifeguard. All in seconds.

See How It WorksView Dashboard

How It Works

From detection to deployment in under 30 seconds. Every second counts when someone is drowning.

STEP 01

Detect

AI spots humans in distress using RGB + thermal imaging with 94% confidence.

STEP 02

Track

Locks onto target and maintains persistent visual tracking through waves and glare.

STEP 03

Alert

Pings the nearest qualified lifeguard instantly via the SALVO responder network.

STEP 04

Deploy

Launches a tethered flotation device in seconds — buying critical time until help arrives.

Built for the Edge

Real-time AI inference on a portable platform. No cloud dependency. No latency. Just action.

01NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano — Edge AI Brain
02FLIR Lepton 3.5 / Boson Thermal Camera
031080p RGB @ 30fps Wide-Angle Lens
04ESP32 Control System — Servo + Winch
05250–500g Rescue Payload Capacity
065–10m Throw Range — 15–30m Tether
07Dual-Stage Safety Arming (Physical + Software)
